title: IDPC Decision 2026: CCTV camera capturing disputed passage over rural land.
text:
Type: Data Protection complaint

Description: CCTV camera capturing disputed passage over rural land.

Outcome: Until the legal status of the passage over the field of the controller can be legally or judicially determined, the Commissioner is unable to verify  whether the processing activity conducted by means of the CCTV cameras installed by the controller falls within the material scope of the Regulation, and therefore, the Commissioner is consequently dismissing the complaint lodged.

Corrective Action: N/A
